# Finra API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Documentation Index
- `SKILL.md` (this file)
- `references/REFERENCE.md` (detailed endpoint docs)
- `references/ENDPOINTS.json` (machine-readable endpoint catalog)

## Authentication
Custom Token (x-auth-token) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Data Read (1)
- `GET /data/guide.json/{guide.jsonId}` — Retrieve a specific data guide JSON file.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /privaci/v1/consent/cookie/singleupload` — Upload a single cookie consent record.
- `POST /wa/` — Submit data via the WA endpoint.

### Media (2)
- `GET /css/cubano` — Retrieve a CSS stylesheet.
- `GET /data/guide.gif/{guide.gifId}` — Retrieve a specific data guide GIF image.

### Core API (2)
- `GET /attribution_trigger` — Trigger attribution tracking.
- `GET /core/v1/utils/geo/location` — Get geographic location information.

## Quick Start

### OpenClaw (Unbrowse) workflow
- Authenticate in the browser first (no credentials are shipped with this skill).
- Capture fresh auth locally: run `unbrowse_capture` on an authenticated page for this domain.
- Execute via backend gate + client browser executor: `unbrowse_replay` with `executionMode="backend"`.

Example:
```text
unbrowse_replay { service: "finra", executionMode: "backend", endpoint: "GET /data/guide.json/{guide.jsonId}" }
```

Here are a few examples to get you started:

```typescript
// Retrieve geographic location information.
async function getLocation() {
  const locationData = await client.core.v1.utils.geo.location.get();
  console.log("Location Data:", locationData);
  return locationData;
}
```

```typescript
// Upload a single cookie consent record.
async function uploadCookieConsent(consentData: any) {
  try {
    const response = await client.privaci.v1.consent.cookie.singleupload.post(consentData);
    console.log("Cookie consent upload response:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error uploading cookie consent:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Finra's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Finra data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.finra.org (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Finra frontend uses

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { FinraClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

// Load captured auth from auth.json
const client = await FinraClient.fromAuthFile("auth.json");

// Make requests to internal endpoints
const result = await client.get("/endpoint");
```

## Captured Authentication

The `auth.json` file contains credentials extracted from browser traffic:
- **Auth headers:** 2 (sec-fetch-storage-access, x-auth-token)
- **Session cookies:** 28

If auth expires, re-run `unbrowse_login` or `unbrowse_capture` to refresh tokens.

## Error Handling

```typescript
try {
  const data = await client.get("/resource");
} catch (err) {
  if (err.message.includes("401")) {
    // Auth expired — need to re-capture
    console.error("Auth expired, re-run unbrowse_login");
  } else {
    console.error("API error:", err.message);
  }
}
```
